_readme: Pinned sha256 of every file that executes during a build (or decides what does). Verified by scripts/verify-build-integrity.mjs in the build-chain-guard CI job. Any drift fails CI until someone regenerates this file on purpose: `node scripts/verify-build-integrity.mjs --update`. Exists because of the 2026-06-01 incident — see the header of that script.
_contentScannedReadme: Build-executed files the SEO agent is deliberately allowed to write, so they are NOT hash-pinned above — a pin would be red on every content PR and would turn `--update` into a reflex, which is the one habit that empties this control of meaning. Their control is gate 1b (scripts/check-agent-blog-content.mjs), a heuristic token scan, NOT a proof. Listed here so the registry of build-executed files is complete: verify-build-integrity.mjs fails if one of these disappears or if .github/workflows/ci.yml stops naming it, i.e. if it silently loses its coverage.

contentScanned.lib/blog-topics.ts: Imported by app/blog/page.tsx, app/blog/topics/page.tsx, app/blog/topics/[topic]/page.tsx and app/sitemap.ts — all statically rendered by `next build`, so it executes on the Vercel builder with production secrets. The SEO prompt in .github/workflows/seo-content.yml tells the agent to register every new post in it, and step 4a of docs/SECURITY-HARDENING.md grants Write/Edit on it, so it cannot be hash-pinned without breaking the pipeline. Scanned by gate 1b instead.

_mustNotExistReadme: Filenames the toolchain picks up automatically. None of these exist today; if one appears, it changes what runs at build time without changing any file that is already reviewed. Adding one is a deliberate act that has to be recorded here.
_allowedLifecycleScriptsReadme: npm lifecycle hooks that are allowed to exist in package.json. These run automatically on `npm ci` — on the CI runner and on the Vercel builder, with production secrets in the environment. The list is empty and should stay empty; nothing in this repo needs one. `--update` will NOT add entries here for you.
